_doc: Per-dosha sleep guidance. Engine reads: bedtime (HH:MM), routine (list). Optional: poor_sleep_routine (appended when sleep < 6h or quality <= 4) and high_stress_routine (appended when stress >= 7). Bedtime is shifted 20 minutes earlier automatically for poor sleep. Classical dinacharya-inspired wellness guidance, not medical advice.

routine: Finish dinner by 7:00 PM — keep it warm and light
Dim lights and switch off screens 45 minutes before bed
Massage warm sesame oil on your feet and scalp (classical Vata practice)
5 minutes of slow, deep breathing once in bed
Keep the bedroom warm, quiet and dark
Aim for the same bedtime every night — Vata thrives on regularity
poor_sleep_routine: Take a warm bath or shower 1 hour before bed
Sip warm spiced milk with a pinch of nutmeg (if dairy suits you)
Write down tomorrow's tasks and worries to offload the mind
Listen to soft, slow instrumental music (see tonight's raga suggestions)
high_stress_routine: Body-scan relaxation from feet to head (5-8 minutes)

routine: Finish dinner by 7:30 PM — avoid late, heavy or spicy meals
No work email or difficult discussions after 9:00 PM
Dim the lights; keep the bedroom cool and airy
5 minutes of cooling breathing (sheetali) or slow deep breathing
Light reading or gentle stretching — avoid stimulating content
poor_sleep_routine: Keep the room extra cool tonight and use only a light blanket
Avoid caffeine after 2 PM and heavy meals after 8 PM
Try 10 minutes of guided yoga nidra in bed
high_stress_routine: A slow 10-minute walk in the evening air
Write a 3-line journal: what went well, what can wait until tomorrow
Exhale-focused breathing (longer exhale than inhale) for 5 minutes

routine: Keep dinner light and finish by 7:00 PM
A brisk 10-15 minute walk after dinner
Avoid daytime naps — they make night sleep heavier
Avoid heavy sweets and dairy in the evening
Warm shower before bed; keep the room slightly cool and fresh
poor_sleep_routine: Commit to a firm wake-up time tomorrow, even if tonight is short
No screens in bed — read something light instead
A few minutes of gentle stretching before bed
high_stress_routine: Journaling to clear the mind before bed
Slow, steady breathing: 4 seconds in, 6 seconds out
